steps.note: File names are case-sensitive. Also create the folders SmartFlow/Modules, SmartFlow/Scripts, SmartFlow/Workspace and SmartFlow/Playground.

steps.question: Does the user already have an AGENTS.md in the config folder (or wherever AGENTS.md files need to go)?
steps.yes: Merge the two. Keep the user's content and put the SmartFlow section at the top. Never delete the user's rules.

steps.note: Place SmartFlow.md and the SmartFlow/ folder next to AGENTS.md in the config folder.

steps.question: Do you want to start SmartFlow now?
steps.yes: Read AGENTS.md, run the Setup function, then follow SmartFlow.md
